trace.cypher: MATCH (t:Team)-[:MentionedIn]->(:Document), (o:Owner)-[:Owns]->(t) WHERE o.name = 'William Chisholm' RETURN DISTINCT t.founded_year AS col1, o.name AS col2, t.team_name AS col3, t.team_name AS name_team
MATCH (o:Owner)-[:Owns]->(t:Team) WHERE o.name = 'William Chisholm' RETURN t.founded_year AS col1, o.name AS col2, t.team_name AS col3, t.team_name AS name_team

MATCH (o:Owner)-[:Owns]->(t:Team) WHERE LOWER(o.name) CONTAINS 'william' AND LOWER(o.name) CONTAINS 'chisholm' RETURN t.founded_year AS col1, o.name AS col2, t.team_name AS col3, t.team_name AS name_team
MATCH (o:Owner)-[:Owns]->(t:Team) WHERE LOWER(o.name) CONTAINS 'chisholm' RETURN t.founded_year AS col1, o.name AS col2, t.team_name AS col3, t.team_name AS name_team
